description: This file implements the AT command channel handling for Android's radio interface layer, including reading/writing to the AT command stream, processing responses, and managing communication with the radio hardware.

methods.name: at_open
methods.description: Initializes the AT channel on a given file descriptor and sets the unsolicited handler.

methods.name: at_close
methods.description: Closes the AT channel and terminates the reader thread.

methods.name: at_send_command
methods.description: Sends a simple AT command with no expected intermediate response.

methods.name: at_send_command_singleline
methods.description: Sends an AT command expecting a single line response with a specific prefix.

methods.name: at_send_command_numeric
methods.description: Sends an AT command expecting a numeric response.

methods.name: at_send_command_sms
methods.description: Sends an AT command with a PDU for SMS and expects a response.

methods.name: at_send_command_multiline
methods.description: Sends an AT command expecting multiple lines in response.

methods.name: at_set_on_timeout
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be invoked on command timeout.

methods.name: at_set_on_reader_closed
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be invoked when the reader thread detects the input stream is closed.

methods.name: at_handshake
methods.description: Performs a handshake with the radio to ensure the AT channel is active.

methods.name: at_get_cme_error
methods.description: Extracts the CME error code from an AT response.
